caveats: Both KGW source URLs timed out and were skipped; verification rests on the KATU article (published 2026-03-31) and the MCSO statement. Suit was filed 2026-03-31 in U.S. District Court in Portland by a former female inmate against ex-corrections deputy Edwin Diaz; a settlement conference was scheduled for April 1 but no resolution was reported, so 'ongoing' reflects status as of early April 2026. Accused was a corrections deputy at the county jail, but the employing agency is the sheriff's office, hence agency_category 'sheriff'. Diaz was indicted June 2025 on 25 counts (sexual abuse, custodial sexual misconduct, official misconduct) and pleaded not guilty; no trial date set in sources.
